headline: City buildings rise in CIVILIZATION V
lede: The arcade's oldest cut — cities that build only units and wonders — gets its first slice back: Granary, Library, Walls, Workshop and Market now raise on city yards, per-city and tech-gated, with the AI raising its lots too. And three bugs that were live on main died on the way.

notes.text: A (or the A·BUILD button) opens the builder on the ordered city: five named buildings with live progress, honest refusals by tech name, and the yard announcing the raise. Effects are real — food, science, gold, production and city defence move; Walls stack flat before the Great Wall's multiplier; a captured city keeps what stands.

Costs are deliberately small (25–40 shields): measured runs showed the size-4 golden shortcut crowns around turn ten, so a 40-shield building would never stand in a winning game. The first lot has to be the cheapest thing on the board.

Three shipped bugs fell: the HUD build-slot line crashed the frame loop on any non-unit queue head; a Space tapped within one frame of ordering silently dropped the order; and the Ark WELD button/Q had been answering NULL on every press since #2077 — the UI path was dead because the harness only ever drove the test hook. 703 Node pins + 109 live Chrome checks now cover all of it.

Still owed honestly on the same gap: a true per-city screen (rush/buy/purchase) and the wider building tree. Verify production by playing it: jalfern.com HTML hashes are CDN-stale on purpose; live key-drive is the truth.
